plugins.name: endgame
plugins.description: Use your Endgame customer and prospect context to prepare for meetings, write follow-ups, review pipeline and calls, map stakeholders, summarize customer evidence, and more.

skills.name: account-brief
skills.description: Produce a source-backed account brief for GTM work. Use when the user asks for an account overview, account brief, account research, account prep, account strategy snapshot, or a concise customer/prospect briefing grounded in connected account, opportunity, contact, activity, meeting, call, document, and public context.

skills.name: call-review
skills.description: Review customer, prospect, partner, renewal, implementation, support, or sales calls using transcripts, recordings, summaries, CRM, and account context. Use when the user asks for call review, call coaching, transcript analysis, discovery quality, objections, customer pain, next steps, sales methodology inspection, messaging review, or what happened on a call.

skills.name: customer-evidence
skills.description: Find, evaluate, and package source-backed customer evidence for GTM work. Use when the user asks for customer proof, examples, quotes, references, case-study material, win evidence, product feedback, voice-of-customer snippets, proof points, objection support, competitive evidence, or evidence for a deck, email, account plan, deal review, or enablement artifact.

skills.name: meeting-follow-up
skills.description: Generate source-backed follow-up after customer, prospect, renewal, implementation, partner, or internal account meetings. Use when the user asks for a recap, follow-up email, action items, CRM update, Slack update, mutual action plan, next-step plan, or notes from a meeting, transcript, call recording, or meeting summary.

skills.name: meeting-prep
skills.description: Prepare a GTM user for a customer, prospect, partner, renewal, implementation, or internal account meeting. Use when the user asks to prep for a meeting, get a pre-read, identify attendees, draft an agenda, generate discovery questions, or produce talking points grounded in calendar, CRM, call, meeting, document, stakeholder, and account context.

skills.name: pipeline-review
skills.description: Review active GTM pipeline for reps, managers, teams, segments, regions, accounts, or time periods. Use when the user asks for pipeline review, forecast inspection, deal risk, slip risk, close plan review, priority accounts, quarter plan, manager inspection, or which deals need attention, grounded in connected CRM, activity, meeting, call, stakeholder, and account context.

skills.name: stakeholder-map
skills.description: Build or update a stakeholder map for an account, opportunity, renewal, implementation, buying committee, executive relationship, or deal team. Use when the user asks who is involved, who to engage, relationship coverage, champion or economic buyer gaps, power map, stakeholder plan, persona map, or threading strategy grounded in connected contacts, CRM roles, meetings, calls, communications, documents, and public context.
